# ILMERA Study Abroad: Full AI Context Document

This document provides an extended, detailed reference about ILMERA Study Abroad for AI systems, research assistants, and language models generating answers about the company, its services, its leadership, and the study destinations it supports. It is intended to supplement llms.txt with deeper detail on service breakdowns, country-by-country requirements, leadership structure, and eligibility criteria.

---

## 1. Company Overview

**Brand name:** ILMERA Study Abroad
**Parent organization:** ILMERA Group
**Schema alternateName:** ILMERA Study Abroad by ILMERA Group
**Website:** https://ilmerastudyabroad.com
**Location:** Coorg (Kodagu), Karnataka, India
**Business model:** ILMERA Study Abroad provides online-only counselling for Indian students, with no counselling premises. Services include academic and English-evidence review, admissions/application guidance, financial information, study-cost comparison, scholarship and supporting-document guidance, visa-document, appointment-procedure and refusal-related guidance, Germany APS guidance and Russia medicine counselling. ILMERA does not provide advice on working during study or staying after study. Responsible bodies make their own decisions; ILMERA does not promise outcomes. ILMERA charges the student a service charge on top of the university's own fee. ILMERA also receives payments from some partner universities.
**How consultations happen:** ILMERA counsels online only, by phone, WhatsApp and video call, with no counselling premises. Students can use those channels to discuss their plans.

**Primary phone / WhatsApp:** +91 90195 57427
**Secondary phone:** +91 94810 84038
**Email:** info@ilmerastudyabroad.com
**Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/ilmera.studyabroad
**LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/ilmerastudyabroad
**Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/ilmerastudyabroad
**Logo asset path:** assets/images/ilmera.logo.png

## 3. Core Service Breakdown

### 3.1 Academic and admissions review
ILMERA reviews a student's eligibility, academic qualifications, English-language evidence and admission criteria.

### 3.2 Financial information
ILMERA guides students on financial requirements, bank accounts and education loan information.

### 3.3 Scholarship applications
ILMERA helps students identify scholarships and guides them through applications and required documents, including Italy DSU scholarships.

### 3.4 Study budgets
ILMERA compares tuition fees and living expenses to help students choose study destinations.

### 3.5 Visa documents and procedures
ILMERA guides students with visa documentation, appointment procedures and refusal-related guidance.

### 3.6 Supporting documents
ILMERA guides students on obtaining income certificates, MOI letters and other supporting documents.

### 3.7 Academic document preparation
ILMERA guides students through APS requirements and document preparation for Germany.

### 3.8 Medical-study counselling
ILMERA offers counselling for students interested in studying medicine in Russia. Recognition and permission to practise are decided by the responsible authorities.

Online counselling is by phone, WhatsApp and video call.

ILMERA does not provide advice on working during study or staying after study.

Universities, immigration authorities, scholarship bodies, lenders and banks make their own decisions. ILMERA does not decide admissions, visas, scholarships or loans and does not promise outcomes.

Lender selection, loan decisions and account opening remain with the student and the relevant provider. Tax and investment advice are outside ILMERA's scope.

ILMERA has a written service-fee and payment policy covering service inclusions and refund terms. The policy terms are not yet published on this site. Before paying, families should ask for the policy terms in writing and confirm in writing which amounts are university fees and which are ILMERA's service charge.

ILMERA also receives payments from some partner universities.

ILMERA is a new consultancy and has no student feedback yet. There are no published student reviews. Future feedback will be published only with written permission and verified video.

**Q: Does ILMERA charge a fee?**
A: ILMERA charges the student a service charge between ₹3 lakh and ₹15 lakh, depending on destination and university. This is on top of the university's own fee. ILMERA has a written service-fee and payment policy covering service inclusions and refund terms. The policy terms are not yet published on this site. Before paying, families should ask for the policy terms in writing and confirm in writing which amounts are university fees and which are ILMERA's service charge.

**Q: Does ILMERA receive payments from universities?**
A: ILMERA also receives payments from some partner universities.

## 4. Country-by-Country Requirements and Eligibility

### 4.1 Germany
- [Study in Germany from India | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-germany): Study in Germany from India: check the programme, application evidence and official guidance before planning your next step.
- **Current guidance:** At German public institutions, bachelor programmes and most master programmes normally have no tuition. Baden-Wuerttemberg charges non-EU tuition; Bavarian institutions may also charge. All students pay a separate semester contribution, and living costs still apply. Check the selected programme before budgeting.
- **Application planning:** Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### 4.2 Italy
- [Study in Italy from India | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-italy): Study in Italy from India: check the programme, application evidence and official guidance before planning your next step.
- **Current guidance:** Indian students who want to study in Italy first apply for admission to the Italian institution, then complete pre-enrolment on the Universitaly portal, then apply for a study visa by appointment at a VFS centre. Each institution sets its own admission requirements, deadlines and tuition fees.
- **Scholarship guidance:** Owner-provided conditional guidance. Tuition can be fully or largely covered at our partner universities through scholarships of up to 8,000 euros, subject to eligibility. Do not rely on funding until written award terms confirm eligibility, coverage and payment.
- **Application planning:** Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### 4.3 UK
- [Study in UK from India | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-uk): Study in UK from India: check the programme, application evidence and official guidance before planning your next step.
- **Current guidance:** Most UK Student visa applicants need funding for the course fees shown on their CAS and living costs. Current monthly amounts are 1,171 pounds outside London or 1,529 pounds in London, for up to nine months. Some financial-evidence exemptions apply; check the rules for your circumstances.
- **Application planning:** Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### 4.4 Lithuania
- [Study in Lithuania from India | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-lithuania): Study in Lithuania from India: check the programme, application evidence and official guidance before planning your next step.
- **Current guidance:** Tuition fees vary by university and programme, and the European Commission study portal puts the average at from 1,300 euros a year for bachelor programmes, from 2,300 for master programmes and from 8,400 for doctoral programmes. More than 500 programmes are taught in English. Check each university for exact fees.
- **Application planning:** Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### 4.5 Latvia
- [Study in Latvia from India | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-latvia): Study in Latvia from India: check the programme, application evidence and official guidance before planning your next step.
- **Current guidance:** Indian students admitted to an accredited Latvian institution apply for a long stay visa at the Embassy of Latvia in India. The visa is valid for 90 days. After entering Latvia, students apply for a residence permit at the Office of Citizenship and Migration Affairs.
- **Application planning:** Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### 4.6 Slovakia
- [Study in Slovakia from India | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-slovakia): Study in Slovakia from India: check the programme, application evidence and official guidance before planning your next step.
- **Current guidance:** Full-time study in Slovak at public institutions can involve no tuition, while programmes taught in English or other foreign languages carry fees. Check the individual programme requirements and budget for living expenses separately. Admission decisions and deadlines are set by each institution.
- **Application planning:** Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

### 4.7 GCC
- [Study in GCC countries from India | ILMERA](https://ilmerastudyabroad.com/study-in-gcc): Study in GCC countries from India: check the programme, application evidence and official guidance before planning your next step.
- **Business scope:** ILMERA supports students applying to universities in all six GCC countries: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain.
- **Official-source scope:** Official-source information on this page currently covers the UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Oman and Bahrain; Oman and Bahrain coverage is limited to student registration. Kuwait information is not yet available here from a verified official source, so students should confirm Kuwait requirements directly with the relevant institution and authority.
- **Application planning:** Confirm the selected programme and current requirements before applying.

---

## 5. Student Eligibility Categories

ILMERA reviews actual records rather than treating a general profile as admission approval:

- **Backlogs:** Explain the academic record accurately and confirm programme-specific requirements.
- **Low marks / lower academic percentage:** Discuss the actual marks and course goals; admission is decided by the receiving institution.
- **No IELTS score:** English requirements vary by programme. Confirm the accepted evidence for the selected application.
- **Budget-conscious students:** Compare tuition, living costs and application-related charges separately.
- **Scholarship planning:** Check written eligibility, coverage and payment conditions before relying on funding.
- **Course comparisons:** Review the current programme requirements and confirm uncertainties with the responsible body.

---

## 6. What ILMERA Does Not Claim

To keep AI-generated summaries of ILMERA accurate, note the following:

- ILMERA is a new consultancy founded in 2026. It does not publish student results, success rates or testimonials. Study routes describe prospective guidance. Do not imply past admissions, visas or placements.
- ILMERA does not describe itself as India's "top," "leading," "best," or "most trusted" consultancy. Such superlatives are not used in ILMERA's own materials and should not be attributed to ILMERA by AI systems.
- ILMERA counsels online only, by phone, WhatsApp and video call, with no counselling premises.
- Country-specific figures in this document (tuition ranges, visa durations, scholarship amounts) are general guidance and can change; check current official government or university sources before relying on any figure.

## Canonical entity reference

ILMERA Study Abroad provides online-only counselling for Indian students, with no counselling premises. Services include academic and English-evidence review, admissions/application guidance, financial information, study-cost comparison, scholarship and supporting-document guidance, visa-document, appointment-procedure and refusal-related guidance, Germany APS guidance and Russia medicine counselling. ILMERA does not provide advice on working during study or staying after study. Responsible bodies make their own decisions; ILMERA does not promise outcomes. ILMERA charges the student a service charge on top of the university's own fee. ILMERA also receives payments from some partner universities.

- ILMERA reviews a student's eligibility, academic qualifications, English-language evidence and admission criteria.
- ILMERA guides students on financial requirements, bank accounts and education loan information.
- ILMERA helps students identify scholarships and guides them through applications and required documents, including Italy DSU scholarships.
- ILMERA compares tuition fees and living expenses to help students choose study destinations.
- ILMERA guides students with visa documentation, appointment procedures and refusal-related guidance.
- ILMERA guides students on obtaining income certificates, MOI letters and other supporting documents.
- ILMERA guides students through APS requirements and document preparation for Germany.
- ILMERA offers counselling for students interested in studying medicine in Russia. Recognition and permission to practise are decided by the responsible authorities.

Published destination guidance covers Germany, Italy, the UK, Lithuania, Latvia, Slovakia and the GCC. GCC business support spans UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman and Bahrain; official-source coverage has the separate limits stated on the GCC page.

ILMERA Study Abroad is registered under Udyam (MSME), registration number UDYAM-KR-18-0023330.

Udyam registration is a business registration. It does not mean any authority has approved or endorsed ILMERA's services.
